description: InterPro domain architecture of Q8DHP3 and AlphaFold pLDDT/PAE decomposition to test for an accessory carbohydrate-binding module
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
# ---- InterPro domain architecture of Q8DHP3 (direct API result, not inference) ----
url="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api/entry/all/protein/uniprot/Q8DHP3/?page_size=200"
r=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=120)
print("InterPro API HTTP %d"%r.status_code)
js=r.json()
print("entries matched: %d\n"%js["count"])
rows=[]
for e in js["results"]:
    md=e["metadata"]
    for pr in e["proteins"]:
        for loc in pr["entry_protein_locations"]:
            for f in loc["fragments"]:
                rows.append((md["source_database"],md["accession"],md["type"],(md.get("name") or "")[:58],f["start"],f["end"]))
rows.sort(key=lambda t:(t[4],t[5]))
print("%-10s %-12s %-12s %-58s %s"%("db","accession","type","name","range"))
for d,a,t,n,s,e in rows: print("%-10s %-12s %-12s %-58s %d-%d"%(d,a,t,n,s,e))
cbm=[x for x in rows if "CBM" in (x[3] or "").upper() or "carbohydrate-binding" in (x[3] or "").lower() or "ricin" in (x[3] or "").lower()]
print("\ncarbohydrate-binding module / lectin entries found: %d  %s"%(len(cbm),cbm if cbm else "(none)"))
cov=np.zeros(386,dtype=bool)
for d,a,t,n,s,e in rows:
    if d in ("pfam","cathgene3d","superfamily","interpro"): cov[s:e+1]=True
unc=[i for i in range(1,386) if not cov[i]]
print("residues of the 385-aa UniProt sequence not covered by any Pfam/CATH/SUPERFAMILY/InterPro entry: %d"%len(unc))
if unc:
    # contiguous blocks
    blocks=[];st=unc[0];pv=unc[0]
    for i in unc[1:]:
        if i!=pv+1: blocks.append((st,pv)); st=i
        pv=i
    blocks.append((st,pv))
    print("uncovered blocks >=20 aa:", [b for b in blocks if b[1]-b[0]>=19])

# ---- pLDDT / PAE domain decomposition of the AlphaFold model ----
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8DHP3",headers=H,timeout=90).json()[0]
txt=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],headers=H,timeout=120).text
pl={int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in txt.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM  ") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}
res=np.array(sorted(pl)); v=np.array([pl[i] for i in res])
print("\nAlphaFold AF-Q8DHP3-F1 (%s): mean pLDDT %.1f"%(meta["pdbUrl"].split("/")[-1],v.mean()))
print("  barrel region 60-300: mean pLDDT %.1f"%v[(res>=60)&(res<=300)].mean())
print("  N-terminal 1-59    : mean pLDDT %.1f"%v[res<60].mean())
print("  C-terminal 301-385 : mean pLDDT %.1f"%v[res>300].mean())
pae=requests.get(meta["paeDocUrl"],headers=H,timeout=120).json()[0]
P=np.array(pae["predicted_aligned_error"],dtype=float)
def blk(a,b,c,d): return P[a-1:b,c-1:d].mean()
print("  mean PAE within barrel (60-300): %.1f A"%blk(60,300,60,300))
print("  mean PAE within C-term (301-385): %.1f A"%blk(301,385,301,385))
print("  mean PAE barrel vs C-term       : %.1f A  (high = independently placed module)"%blk(60,300,301,385))
print("  mean PAE barrel vs N-term(1-59) : %.1f A"%blk(60,300,1,59))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.2))
ax[0].plot(res,v,lw=1,color="#1864ab"); ax[0].axhline(90,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); ax[0].axhline(70,ls=":",c="grey",lw=1)
for s,e,lab,c in [(1,59,"N-term",'#ffd8a8'),(60,300,"GH10 barrel",'#b2f2bb'),(301,385,"C-term beta-sandwich",'#d0bfff')]:
    ax[0].axvspan(s,e,alpha=.45,color=c); ax[0].text((s+e)/2,54,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue (UniProt Q8DHP3 numbering; add 27 for WP_164920949.1)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax[0].set_ylim(50,100); ax[0].set_title("Tlr1902 model confidence",fontsize=10)
im=ax[1].imshow(P,cmap="viridis_r",vmin=0,vmax=30)
for b in (59,300): ax[1].axhline(b,c="w",lw=.8); ax[1].axvline(b,c="w",lw=.8)
ax[1].set_title("Predicted aligned error (A)",fontsize=10); ax[1].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[1].set_ylabel("residue")
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[1],fraction=.046)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
